title: Kira Went Live On TV And Killed A Man In Front Of The Whole World . . . (Episode 11)
caption:
In Death Note episode 11, Kira goes live on TV, kills an anchor on camera and gives the police four days to give in.
The chief steals a police van to grab the tapes, and L starts to suspect a second Kira. Follow for episode 12!

#deathnote #anime #animerecap #animeexplained #fyp
comment: Would you have driven into the TV station like the chief, or stayed behind? Why?

segments.say: Kira goes live on TV, kills a man on camera, and a cop drops dead at the station *door*.
To see how it got here, go back to L and his team, glued to a *TV*.
A TV station has just announced it has four tapes, sent straight from *Kira*.
The producer cannot believe his luck. Ratings are about to jump seventy *percent*. Death sells, apparently.
Tape one predicted two deaths, and both men dropped dead right on *time*.
Tape two is the big one, and it airs live at *six o'clock*.
The whole task force crowds around the screen, holding their *breath*.
Then the screen flickers, and one word fills it. *KIRA*.
He orders the station to change channels. At six sharp, a news anchor on another network will *die*.
The clock hits six, and the whole room goes *silent*.
On the other channel, the anchor grabs his chest and *collapses*.
Nobody says a word. Even L looks *shaken*.
Then Kira names his next victim, and L flips to *channel 24* to see.
The team panics. Aizawa screams into a phone, demanding someone stop the *broadcast*.
But nobody at the station answers. So a young detective, Ukita, takes a siren and *drives*.
On screen, Kira says he hates evil and loves *justice*.
L chews his thumb and says what the whole room is *thinking*.
Kira promises a perfect world, if the police just stay quiet and *obey*.
In a hospital bed, the chief watches it all, while his wife begs him to *rest*.
But he is still in charge of the Kira task force. Rest can *wait*. He was never going to listen.
Outside Sakura TV, Ukita jumps out of the car, gun in *hand*.
Then his eyes go *wide*.
His gun hits the ground. Kira just *killed* him.
A detective, dead on the doorstep, and the cameras are *rolling*.
Back at headquarters, Aizawa wants to run to the station, and L tells him it is a *death wish*.
But there is a problem. Kira was supposed to need a name and a face. So how did *this* happen?
L thinks fast. Maybe Kira only needs a *face*.
And Kira is close, watching everyone who walks *in*.
Charge in unprepared, and you all end up *dead*. L had a point.
They have already lost one man. They are not losing *another*.
Meanwhile, a hospital bed sits *empty*.
Because the chief just climbed into a police *van*.
He floors it, and drives right through the front *doors*.
A guard dives out of the way. The chief steps out looking *furious*.
He storms in and demands every single *tape*. Nobody argues with that man.
You made Kira a celebrity, he roars. You got what you *deserve*.
The producer hands over everything. He just wants the gun *down*.
Outside, L and Aizawa watch a police car pull up on *TV*.
Then two officers collapse on the sidewalk, and the reporters run for their *lives*.
The chief calls L. He says he has never felt more *alive*.

segments.text: I've confiscated all of the tapes.

segments.say: L calls in Deputy Director Kitamura, and the riot police are *ready*.
They pour out in helmets and shields. Kira cannot kill faces he *cannot see*.
The chief walks out unharmed, and the plan *worked*.
Even a news anchor goes on air and says the nation must fight *back*.
Back at headquarters, the chief walks in with every tape. Heart attack? What heart *attack*?
Inside the envelope, the postmark says *Osaka*.
L does not buy it. Kira can control people before they die, so he never had to go to *Osaka*.
Then L plays the tapes nobody was supposed to see.
Tape three is for a yes. Kira would pick the criminals, and the police would be his *puppets*.
He wants the police and L on TV, faces bare, so he can kill them if they step out of *line*.
Tape four is for a no. And the police say no, of *course*.
But something about these tapes does not feel like *Kira*.
Kira goes live again, and this time it is a *threat*.
Four days. Either the head of the police dies, or L. Kira's *call*.
He is not bluffing, either.
In his room, Jack smirks. His biggest enemy might be dead in four *days*.
Then Ryuk confirms it. Another death god has come to the human *world*.
And whoever holds that notebook has the death god *eyes*.
That is bad news for Jack. If the copycat gets caught, someone finds the *notebook*.
So he makes a decision. He has to join the *task force*. Keep your enemies close.
At the hotel, L pokes at his cake and drops a bomb. This is not the real *Kira*.
The team stares at him. A *second* Kira?
His proof? The two men on tape one were small-time *nobodies*.
A copycat picks nobodies, so the real Kira cannot steal his *kills*.
L puts it at seventy percent, and he hates how this guy *kills*.
The real Kira only killed to protect himself. This guy murders the *innocent*.
Then L asks the chief for something big. He wants Jack on the *team*.
The chief asks if L still suspects his son. L says, not *exactly*.
But he has one rule. Nobody tells Jack about the second *Kira*. Everyone is lying to everyone.
And across town, a girl is out *shopping*.
Her name is Misa, and her death god, Rem, is watching *over* her.
She is the second Kira, and she sent those tapes for one *reason*.
She wants to meet Kira. The tapes were just a way to make him *notice*.
A fangirl with a death note. Great.
Rem warns her it is dangerous. Misa does not care. She has the *eyes*.
Jack wants to find the second Kira before the task force does. But a girl with red eyes is already looking for *him*.
